propositions: Both .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml and reconcile-bridge-canary.yml contain duplicated inline YAML CAS loops that must be replaced with single invocations to python -m rebar._store.push core entrypoints
The reconciler workflow must invoke commit-and-push with --tracker, --message, --author-name, --author-email, and --strict flags while preserving configured bot identity and exact commit subject
The canary workflow must invoke push with --tracker and --strict flags to enforce synchronous strict-mode delivery, overriding project config sync.push=off via REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always
Both workflows must reject and exit nonzero on push failure while preserving pending commits, maintaining red-on-merge-conflict behavior and current delivery semantics
Executable workflow smoke tests must validate complete argparse-compliant command shapes, real git delivery, identity preservation, and strict-mode exit codes against temporary repositories
Legacy YAML loop extraction tests and merge-command-dependent assertions must be rewritten to assert the new core entrypoint invocation rather than source-text shapes
